test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The price of diesel increases by 5% every year. If the current price of diesel is Rs. 80 per litre, then what will be the price of diesel per litre after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

The price of diesel increases by 5% every year.

The current price of diesel is Rs. 80 per litre

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Price of petrol after 2 years = 80 × 105% × 105%

⇒ 84 × 105%

⇒ 88.2

**∴ The price of diesel per litre after 2 years will be Rs. 88.2.**
